import React, { lazy, Suspense } from "react";
import { BrowserRouter as Router, Routes, Route } from "react-router-dom";
import ProtectedRoute from "./component/Auth/ProtectedRoute";

// Lazy-loaded components


const LoadingFallback = () =>
  React.createElement(
    "div",
    { className: "min-h-screen flex items-center justify-center bg-gray-50" },
    React.createElement(
      "div",
      { className: "flex flex-col items-center" },
      React.createElement(
        "svg",
        {
          className: "animate-spin h-8 w-8 text-[#00717F] mb-2",
          xmlns: "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg",
          fill: "none",
          viewBox: "0 0 24 24",
        },
        React.createElement("circle", {
          className: "opacity-25",
          cx: "12",
          cy: "12",
          r: "10",
          stroke: "currentColor",
          strokeWidth: "4",
        }),
        React.createElement("path", {
          className: "opacity-75",
          fill: "currentColor",
          d: "M4 12a8 8 0 018-8V0C5.373 0 0 5.373 0 12h4zm2 5.291A7.962 7.962 0 014 12H0c0 3.042 1.135 5.824 3 7.938l3-2.647z",
        })
      ),
      React.createElement("span", { className: "text-gray-600" }, "Chargement...")
    )
  );

export default function App() {
  return (
    <Router>
      <Suspense fallback={<LoadingFallback />}>
        <Routes>
          {/* Public Routes */}
          <Route path="/" element={<Login />} />

          {/* Superadmin Routes */}
          <Route path="/Dashboard" element={<ProtectedRoute allowedRoles={["Superadmin"]}><Dashboard /></ProtectedRoute>} />
          <Route path="/AccountSuperadmin" element={<ProtectedRoute allowedRoles={["Superadmin"]}><AccountSuperadmin /></ProtectedRoute>} />
          <Route path="/ChefReports" element={<ProtectedRoute allowedRoles={["Superadmin"]}><ChefReportsSuperAdmin /></ProtectedRoute>} />
          <Route path="/InternReports" element={<ProtectedRoute allowedRoles={["Superadmin"]}><InternReportsSuperAdmin /></ProtectedRoute>} />
          <Route path="/DirectorReports" element={<ProtectedRoute allowedRoles={["Superadmin"]}><DeputyDirectorReportsSuperAdmin /></ProtectedRoute>} />
          <Route path="/InternsPourSuperadmin" element={<ProtectedRoute allowedRoles={["Superadmin"]}><InternsPourSuperadmin /></ProtectedRoute>} />
          <Route path="/PaymentTrackingPourSuperadmin" element={<ProtectedRoute allowedRoles={["Superadmin"]}><PaymentTrackingPourSuperadmin /></ProtectedRoute>} />
          <Route path="/ManageProductsPourSuperadmin" element={<ProtectedRoute allowedRoles={["Superadmin"]}><ManageProductsPourSuperadmin /></ProtectedRoute>} />
          <Route path="/FormerInternsSuperadmin" element={<ProtectedRoute allowedRoles={["Superadmin"]}><FormerInternsSuperadmin /></ProtectedRoute>} />
          
          {/* Suppliers (Superadmin) */}
          <Route path="/Suppliers" element={<ProtectedRoute allowedRoles={["Superadmin"]}><Suppliers /></ProtectedRoute>} />
          <Route path="/CreateSupplier" element={<ProtectedRoute allowedRoles={["Superadmin"]}><CreateSupplier /></ProtectedRoute>} />
          <Route path="/EditSupplier/:id" element={<ProtectedRoute allowedRoles={["Superadmin"]}><EditSupplier /></ProtectedRoute>} />

          {/* Deputydirectors (Superadmin) */}
          <Route path="/Deputydirectors" element={<ProtectedRoute allowedRoles={["Superadmin"]}><Deputydirectors /></ProtectedRoute>} />
          <Route path="/CreateDeputydirector" element={<ProtectedRoute allowedRoles={["Superadmin"]}><CreateDeputydirector /></ProtectedRoute>} />
          <Route path="/EditDeputydirector/:id" element={<ProtectedRoute allowedRoles={["Superadmin"]}><EditDeputydirector /></ProtectedRoute>} />

          {/* Chefs (Superadmin) */}
          <Route path="/Chefs" element={<ProtectedRoute allowedRoles={["Superadmin"]}><Chefs /></ProtectedRoute>} />
          <Route path="/CreateChef" element={<ProtectedRoute allowedRoles={["Superadmin"]}><CreateChef /></ProtectedRoute>} />
          <Route path="/EditChef/:id" element={<ProtectedRoute allowedRoles={["Superadmin"]}><EditChef /></ProtectedRoute>} />

          {/* Chef Routes */}
          <Route path="/DashboardChef" element={<ProtectedRoute allowedRoles={["Chef"]}><DashboardChef /></ProtectedRoute>} />
          <Route path="/CreateMeal" element={<ProtectedRoute allowedRoles={["Chef"]}><CreateMeal /></ProtectedRoute>} />
          <Route path="/MealsForNextDayC" element={<ProtectedRoute allowedRoles={["Chef"]}><MealsForNextDayC /></ProtectedRoute>} />
          <Route path="/ChefProductList" element={<ProtectedRoute allowedRoles={["Chef"]}><ChefProductList /></ProtectedRoute>} />
          <Route path="/ChefInternMealList" element={<ProtectedRoute allowedRoles={["Chef"]}><ChefInternMealList /></ProtectedRoute>} />
          <Route path="/Chef/report-history" element={<ProtectedRoute allowedRoles={["Chef"]}><ReportHistoryChef /></ProtectedRoute>} />
          <Route path="/ChefAccount" element={<ProtectedRoute allowedRoles={["Chef"]}><ChefAccount /></ProtectedRoute>} />
          <Route path="/MainMeals" element={<ProtectedRoute allowedRoles={["Chef"]}><MainMeals /></ProtectedRoute>} />
          <Route path="/PreviousMeals" element={<ProtectedRoute allowedRoles={["Chef"]}><PreviousMeals /></ProtectedRoute>} />
          {/* Deputydirector Routes */}
          <Route path="/DeputyDirectorDashboard" element={<ProtectedRoute allowedRoles={["Deputydirector"]}><DeputyDirectorDashboard /></ProtectedRoute>} />
          <Route path="/AccountDeputydirector" element={<ProtectedRoute allowedRoles={["Deputydirector"]}><AccountDeputydirector /></ProtectedRoute>} />
          <Route path="/Candidates" element={<ProtectedRoute allowedRoles={["Deputydirector"]}><Candidates /></ProtectedRoute>} />
          <Route path="/Selected" element={<ProtectedRoute allowedRoles={["Deputydirector"]}><Selected /></ProtectedRoute>} />
          <Route path="/Interns" element={<ProtectedRoute allowedRoles={["Deputydirector"]}><Interns /></ProtectedRoute>} />
          <Route path="/FormerInterns" element={<ProtectedRoute allowedRoles={["Deputydirector"]}><FormerInterns /></ProtectedRoute>} />
          <Route path="/DeputydirectorCompte" element={<ProtectedRoute allowedRoles={["Deputydirector"]}><DeputydirectorCompte /></ProtectedRoute>} />
          <Route path="/EditIntern/:id" element={<ProtectedRoute allowedRoles={["Deputydirector"]}><EditIntern /></ProtectedRoute>} />
          <Route path="/PaymentTracking" element={<ProtectedRoute allowedRoles={["Deputydirector"]}><PaymentTracking /></ProtectedRoute>} />
          <Route path="/CreateCandidate" element={<ProtectedRoute allowedRoles={["Deputydirector"]}><CreateCandidate /></ProtectedRoute>} />
          <Route path="/CriteriaTable" element={<ProtectedRoute allowedRoles={["Deputydirector"]}><CriteriaTable /></ProtectedRoute>} />
          <Route path="/EditCandidate/:id" element={<ProtectedRoute allowedRoles={["Deputydirector"]}><EditCandidate /></ProtectedRoute>} />
          <Route path="/AbsenceRequests" element={<ProtectedRoute allowedRoles={["Deputydirector"]}><AbsenceRequests /></ProtectedRoute>} />

          {/* Deputydirector Stock Routes */}
          <Route path="/Zones" element={<ProtectedRoute allowedRoles={["Deputydirector"]}><Zones /></ProtectedRoute>} />
          <Route path="/ManageProducts" element={<ProtectedRoute allowedRoles={["Deputydirector"]}><ManageProducts /></ProtectedRoute>} />
          <Route path="/EditProduct/:id" element={<ProtectedRoute allowedRoles={["Deputydirector"]}><EditProduct /></ProtectedRoute>} />
          <Route path="/ManageBons" element={<ProtectedRoute allowedRoles={["Deputydirector"]}><ManageBons /></ProtectedRoute>} />
          <Route path="/AddQuantity" element={<ProtectedRoute allowedRoles={["Deputydirector"]}><AddQuantity /></ProtectedRoute>} />
          <Route path="/Delivery" element={<ProtectedRoute allowedRoles={["Deputydirector"]}><Delivery /></ProtectedRoute>} />
          <Route path="/ManageSortie" element={<ProtectedRoute allowedRoles={["Deputydirector"]}><ManageSortie /></ProtectedRoute>} />
          <Route path="/CreateSortie" element={<ProtectedRoute allowedRoles={["Deputydirector"]}><CreateSortie /></ProtectedRoute>} />
          <Route path="/ManageSortieBons" element={<ProtectedRoute allowedRoles={["Deputydirector"]}><ManageSortieBons /></ProtectedRoute>} />
          <Route path="/EditSortie/:id" element={<ProtectedRoute allowedRoles={["Deputydirector"]}><EditSortie /></ProtectedRoute>} />
          <Route path="/director/report-history" element={<ProtectedRoute allowedRoles={["Deputydirector"]}><ReportHistoryD /></ProtectedRoute>} />

          {/* Intern Routes */}
          <Route path="/InternDashboard" element={<ProtectedRoute allowedRoles={["intern"]}><InternDashboard /></ProtectedRoute>} />
          <Route path="/Accountintern" element={<ProtectedRoute allowedRoles={["intern"]}><Accountintern /></ProtectedRoute>} />
          <Route path="/intern/absences-history" element={<ProtectedRoute allowedRoles={["intern"]}><InternAbsencesHistory /></ProtectedRoute>} />
          <Route path="/intern/add-absences" element={<ProtectedRoute allowedRoles={["intern"]}><InternAddAbsences /></ProtectedRoute>} />
          <Route path="/MealsForNextDayI" element={<ProtectedRoute allowedRoles={["intern"]}><MealsForNextDayI /></ProtectedRoute>} />
          <Route path="/intern/report-history" element={<ProtectedRoute allowedRoles={["intern"]}><ReportHistoryintern /></ProtectedRoute>} />

          {/* Default User Route */}
          <Route path="/DashboardUser" element={<ProtectedRoute allowedRoles={["User", "Superadmin", "Deputydirector", "Supplier"]}><DashboardUser /></ProtectedRoute>} />
        </Routes>
      </Suspense>
    </Router>
  );
}
